business_problem: Tech Mahindra needed a way to extract value from long, complex, unstructured enterprise documents while also proving that generative-AI outputs could be governed, explained, and trusted in regulated customer environments.
solution_summary: Tech Mahindra built its Document AmplifAler platform with IBM to convert document-heavy workflows into governed AI processes. IBM watsonx.ai provides the core AI studio, IBM Granite 13b foundation models and IBM Deep Search supply the multimodel reasoning and retrieval capabilities, and IBM watsonx.governance is embedded to keep every AI-driven process transparent, explainable, and compliant. The platform was designed to interpret documents that mix narrative text, large tables, and images across use cases such as financial reports, contracts, onboarding forms, invoices, and publishing dockets. By combining multi-agent, multimodel extraction and summarization with embedded governance, Document AmplifAler turns unstructured files into searchable intelligence and downstream workflow inputs. Tech Mahindra also used the joint program to create an AI center of excellence and train practitioners so customers can scale adoption beyond single pilots.
